dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL; uses ORCMCPSUB call interface and MCP-based screen handling typical of ORCA system
evidence: COPY W01.INC through W30.INC screen copybooks

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system - hospital admission instruction (Nyuuin Shijisen) settings screen W30
purpose.summary: This program implements the W30 screen of the JMA ORCA medical receipt system, handling configuration of hospital admission instruction settings (Nyuuin Shijisen). It manages screen initialization, data entry, DB read/write via the ORCMCPSUB MCP interface, and screen transitions for system management master data (SYSKANRI code 5007).

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements (50 copybooks) for screen and data layouts
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple screen area copybooks (W01-W30, W98, W99, WERR, WID1, WID2)
EVALUATE on MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT for screen event dispatch
Japanese text in comments (EUC-JP encoded, displayed as latin-1 mojibake)
PERFORM UNTIL loop for DB record iteration
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses proprietary ORCA MCP database interface
SPA (Scratchpad Area) pattern for screen state management
verdict.notes: Comments contain Japanese text encoded in EUC-JP, decoded as latin-1 resulting in mojibake. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 67300 bytes total. The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. Fixed format with max line length 74, consistent with standard COBOL fixed format.
